description: Letter grades, grade points and percentage bands of each bylaw. Each scale belongs to one bylaw only; the bylaw's pass mark decides pass or fail.

alert.quote: “Check the letters against the bylaw PDF before relying on them.”
alert.body: Several percentage lines are split across the PDF text. If the PDF disagrees with a stored band, the PDF wins. Saving new letters clears the verification until the scale is checked again.
alert.allVerified: All scales verified against the PDF

scale.title: {{name}} grade scale
scale.subtitle: From cohort {{cohort}} · {{source}}
scale.noLetters: No letters are stored for this scale.

compare.title: Minimum cutoff comparison
compare.subtitle: Lower bound of each letter in both bylaws. The pass threshold moves by {{delta}} percentage points.
compare.qpConsistent: Each letter carries the same grade points in both bylaws (4.00 max).
compare.qpDiffers: Some letters carry different grade points in the two bylaws.

empty.title: No grade scales stored
empty.body: A scale is created with its bylaw. Add the bylaw first, then enter its letters.

editor.title: Edit letters · {{name}}
editor.description: Enter the bands exactly as the grade article states them. Saving replaces every letter of this scale.
editor.bandRule: Usually the lower bound is included and the upper excluded; the top band includes 100 and F has no lower bound.
editor.verified: I checked these letters against the bylaw PDF
editor.verifiedHint: Leave unchecked if you have not compared them with the original PDF. The scale will then show as not verified.
editor.errorTitle: The letters could not be saved

fieldErrors.must_exceed_min_percentage: must be greater than the lower bound

toast.verified: The {{name}} scale is marked as verified.
toast.unverified: The {{name}} scale is marked as not verified.
